def: Either one of the three common American scaup ducks. See Scaupduck, under Scaup.
Any substance or mixture used to promote the fusion of metalsor minerals, as alkalies, borax, lime, fluorite.
The faculty to which the phrenologists attribute the desire ofacquiring and possessing. Combe.
The price or fare to be paid for passage at a ferry.
More than politic; above or exceeding policy. Milton.
A destructive parasitic worm or insect larva.
